mentions.name: AE2-meets-Factorio production game
mentions.description: A game that blends two production/crafting paradigms: request-based on-demand crafting in the style of AE2 (Applied Energistics 2) versus fully passive production in the style of Factorio, sitting between the two approaches.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am trying to make a game that sits squarely between AE2 style request-based on-demand crafting VS fully passive production akin to Factorio :) Making games is fun!

evidence.value: I am trying to make a game that sits squarely between AE2 style request-based on-demand crafting VS fully passive production akin to Factorio :) Making games is fun!
